BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Vanilla Trading Expanded] Add a Kwazaari Bank.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: With this enabled, you will get a truly dwarven bank that will extort you for all you have.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Medical Expansion - Vaccines] Integrate Vaccines into Beyond Our Reach Lore and Crafting.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: With this enabled, Vaccines will be integrated into the lore of Beyond Our Reach and their crafting will follow BOR medicine and bench tiers before using BOR Drugs.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Core] Replace glitterworld medicine.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Makes it possible to substitute Glitterworld Medicine in any recipe with medicine from Beyond Our Reach.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Core] Enable the Badzaari - the Kwazaaris that turned to life of piracy
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Toggles Badzaari pirate faction content: faction def, pawn kinds and naming rules.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Core] Tenebrals have smelled a challenger. Are you up for the task?
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Toggles Tenebral faction content: faction def, pawn kinds, naming rules and culture.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Omni Core Drill] Integrate Omni Core Drill into Beyond Our Reach Lore.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: With this integration, Omni Core Drill will be retextured, moved to pre-solar tier of technology, cost a lot of Solar resources, and use far more power (also with RePowered).

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [CF Chemfuel Powered Deepdrill] Integrate Chemfuel Powered Deepdrill into Beyond Our Reach Lore.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds BOR fuel-based chemfuel deepdrill variants: an ultra-efficient fuel rod model and a quasar neutronium model with internal-only power output and infestation suppression.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Climate Adjuster into Quasar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves climate adjuster research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Quasar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Weather Controller into Quasar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves weather controller research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Quasar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Toxic Spewer into Solar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves toxic spewer research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Solar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate EMI Dynamo into Solar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves EMI dynamo research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Solar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Sun Blocker into Solar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves sun blocker research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Solar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Smoke Spewer into Solar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves smoke spewer research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Solar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Integrate Defoliator into Solar tier.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves defoliator research into BOR tiering, converts it to BOR materials, and adds a craftable access relay at the Solar forge.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters] Add high power requirements.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds power demand to reverse engineered adjusters with escalating usage from smoke spewer (5000W) up to climate adjuster (50000W).

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Combat Extended] Combat Extended Compatibility.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Too much to describe.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Without Combat extended] Add new mortar shell variants.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds ultra tech level mortar shells that can be used to bombard the enemies.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [ArchotechExpanded] Allow to make Nano-, Pico- and Attomachinery from Nano-, Pico- and Femto-clusters.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds recipes allowing to use Archotech Expanded's materials as ingredients for Beyond Our Reach's similar materials.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [ArchotechExpanded] Add new research for Archotech Expanded bionics.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Bionics from Archotech Expanded will now require a new Archotech-level research to be built; Archotech Mimicry research will be also integrated into the tree.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [ArchotechExpanded] Rebalance Archotech Bench.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rebalances the Archotech Bench around the Beyond Our Reach Lore and materials, making it more expensive to build and use.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [ArchotechExpanded] Merge Archotech Expanded Resources.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Removes the possibility to build the nano-, pico- and attomachinery and changes the recipes to use the BOR's nano-, pico-, and femtoclusters instead.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [ArchotechExpanded] Remove stuff properties from Archotech Expanded -machinery.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Archotech Expanded materials - the nano-, pico- and attomachinery will no longer be usable as build materials - patch is useful to prevent yourself from building indestructible stuff.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Save Our Ship 2] Add Save Our Ship Hypoxia resistance to BOR Lungs.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Will attempt to add Hypoxia resistance to Solar, Quasar, Tenebral and Umbral lungs.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Save Our Ship 2] Add Save Our Ship EVA capability to BOR Armors.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds EVA capability to BOR armors, as well as Royalty-added BOR armors and Rimsenal-added BOR armors.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Royalty] Add Royalty-like permits to Kwazaari faction.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: With this integration, Kwazaari will utilize the Shattered Empire's honor system with their own "honor" - scrip, permits and scrip trader.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Royalty] Add Royalty prestige BOR armor.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Solar, Quasar and Tenebral tiers of Royalty armors (Prestige Recon, Prestige Marine, Cataphract and Prestige cataphract) and allows them to be used with Royal Titles. Kwazaar Bazaar will get a heavy marine variant.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Royalty] Add BOR variants of Royalty implants.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds three tiers of Royalty-like implants to the game: psychic sensitizer, psychic harmonizer, psychic reader, neurocalculator, learning assistant, gastro-analyzer, immunenhancer, coagulator, healing enhancer, toughskin glands, armorskin glands, stoneskin glands, aesthetic shaper, aesthetic nose, reprocessor stomach, circadian assistant, circadian half-cycler, mindscrew, drill arm, field hand, hand talon, elbow blade, knee spike, venom fangs, and venom talon. Combat Extended compatible.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers 1.5] Integrate Rimputers into BOR tech tree
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers' Quantum Computer will be required for all BOR researches.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers (No Dubs Bad Hygiene)] Integrate Rimputers into BOR tech tree
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers' Quantum Computer will be required for all BOR researches.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers 1.5] Improve Rimputers' progress curve
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers research steps will require previous computer type to be connected to allow for research.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers (No Dubs Bad Hygiene)] Improve Rimputers' progress curve
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers research steps will require previous computer type to be connected to allow for research.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers 1.5] Retexture Rimputers' Quantum Computer
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers' Quantum Computer will be retextured to fit BOR theme.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers (No Dubs Bad Hygiene)] Retexture Rimputers' Quantum Computer
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Rimputers' Quantum Computer will be retextured to fit BOR theme.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Replimat] Move Replimat buildings to Beyond tab
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Replimat buildings to Beyond architect tab and puts them in a dropdown.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Replimat] Make the isolinear components craftable with BOR Benches
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds a costly recipe to both tier 2 and tier 3 benches that will allow you to create the isolinear components for Replimat.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Replimat] Rebalance Replimat buildings in line with Beyond Our Reach
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Increases costs and power consumption of the Replimat buildings. Fixes ReplimatHopper's texture placement.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Replimat] Move Replimat research to Quasar tech
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves Replimat research to BOR Tier 2 research and increases its cost.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Replimat] Make Replimat components be carried by Kwazaari traders
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds a trade tag to isolinear module so that it's carried by Kwazaari merchants in bulk.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Repair hubs] Integrate RepairHubs into BOR Research
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves RepairHubs into BOR Research as Solar-tier technology.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Repair hubs] Integrate RepairHubs into cost structure of BOR
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Makes Repair Hubs use BOR materials to be built.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Biotech] Adds Biotech Support for BOR.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Armours, Mechanoids and waste-dependent processes; bionics; xenotypes; pollution pumps and special researches to compliment Biotech.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Biotech] Add BOR tiered mechanitor apparel.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Solar, Quasar and Tenebral variants of mechanitor apparel, with BOR mechtech gating and Combat Extended support when it's loaded.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Dubs Bad Hygiene] Add DBH bionics in BoR tiers.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds the bladder and hygiene enhancer in 3 distinct tiers, with the highest one essentialy removing the bathroom needs.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Even More Linkables] Adds support for Even More Linkables mod
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds linkable support to most benches in BoR and 2 additional power linkables for solar and quasar technology tiers.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [EPOE] Adds BoR tiers of EPOE ribs.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds 4 tiers of EPOE-like ribs, utilizing EPOE materials and drugs.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Fire Control Computers] Add support for Fire Control Computers in BoR Context.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Moves ultra fire control computer to solar-tier and adds 2 additional computers similar in power to archotech one.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [EGI Holograms and Projectors] Integrates EGI Holograms as Tier 2/Tier 3 technologies.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: EGI Holograms - due to their propaganda/learning powers - are very efficient. With this patch, they will require separate research, are buildable like buildings and use BoR power requirements and resources.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Ideology] todo
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: todo.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Kraltech Rebalanced] Adds Kraltech baubles to BoR Benches.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Kraltech components and cures to be craftable using BoR benches.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [LTS Integrated Implants] Adds LTS Integrated Implants features to BOR Implants
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds LTS Integrated Implants features to BOR Implants

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [MedPod] Makes it possible to build isolinear stuff with the BOR resources.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Makes it possible to build isolinear stuff with the BOR resources.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [MedPod] Rebalances MedPod as Quasar technologies.
[Quantum Cooling Redux] Balances the Quantum Coolers to fit into BoR research tree.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Quantum coolers / heaters are resized, rebalanced and integrated with proxyheat/vanilla temperature expanded. The biggest Cooler can be used to cool the entire base, but it's huge and very power consuming. With ProxyHeat/VTE it's a deadly climate changing device.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers] Adds Quantum Computer as requirement for BoR technologies.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Quantum Computer as requirement for BoR technologies.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Rimputers NoDubsBadHygiene] adds Quantum Computer as requirement for BoR technologies.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: adds Quantum Computer as requirement for BoR technologies.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Simple learning] Adds Simple Learning capabilities to BOR computers.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: All the PCs added by BOR will now have a bill tab allowing you to use them as learning stations for your colonists for amazing skill gains.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [RT Solar Flare Shield] Rebalances the Solar Flare Shield so that now it's a Tier 2 (Quasar) technology.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Research is moved to BOR tab, increases the research cost, power requirements and uses BoR resources.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [RT Solar Flare Shield] Adds Solar-level and Tenebral-level Solar Shields.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Solar and Tenebral shields use respective researches and resources. Compared to original Solar Shield, Solar-level shield uses more power when idle and when working, while Tenebral level uses a lot more power when idle and generates power during Solar Flare events.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [TerraPumps] Adds 3 tiers of TerraPumps to allow you to terraform even faster.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds Solar, Quasar and Tenebral tiers of TerraPumps - the terraforming machines. They take far more power but are also faster and more expansive. To prevent architect-menu mess, they come with their own designator dropdowns.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Vanilla Storytellers Expanded - Winston Waves] Add Excellent and Legendary rewards to Winston's pool.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: When using Winston Waves, you are now able to get rewards including BoR items, such as weapons, resources, armors.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Vanilla Skills Expanded] Add BOR-specific Medical expertise for bionic crafting.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds one Medical expertise focused on the BOR_BionicCraftingSpeed stat used for Beyond Our Reach bionic production. Requires Vanilla Skills Expanded.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Vanilla Skills Expanded] Add BOR-specific Intellectual expertise for neutronium synthesis.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds one Intellectual expertise focused on the BOR_Synthesize_Neutronium stat used for Beyond Our Reach neutronium synthesis. Requires Vanilla Skills Expanded.

BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingLabel: [Vanilla Skills Expanded] Add BOR-specific Crafting expertise for neutronium forging.
BeyondOurReachModSettings.ModSettingDef.settingDesc: Adds one Crafting expertise focused on the BOR_QuantumForging stat used for Beyond Our Reach neutronium forging recipes. Requires Vanilla Skills Expanded.
